description: Found by tools/find_mars_mixed_plan_fixture.mjs (real Jezero DEM, assets/mars/) over a bounded search of 8 candidates: 3 waypoints sampled from a spawn->goal A* route, with one leg threaded through a real 23.0deg-class cell (legal at DEFAULT_GUARDRAILS's maxSlopeDeg=25, hazardous at 18). At DEFAULT_GUARDRAILS the ensemble splits between 'arrived' and 'stalled' purely from DRIFT_PCT=1's seeded per-run heading-bias drift pushing the believed-vs-true steering off enough, on some seeds, to lose the approach; at maxSlopeDeg=18 the same threaded cell is flagged a plan-time hazard and the run holds before ever driving, on every seed (planning is deterministic, independent of drift/seed).

measured.note: Measured this session (node, real assets/mars DEM) by tools/find_mars_mixed_plan_fixture.mjs; reproduced independently in tests/ensemble.test.mjs.
measured.looseVsMidDirection: no difference: loose(31,stop) and mid(25,reroute) produced identical counts on this fixture
measured.tippedTradeoffBlocked: The real Mars DEM has zero cells >= the rover's fixed 32deg physical tip limit within 8.3km of spawn (nearest is (271,852) at 32.17deg, 8335m from spawn), and mission.js's STALL_TIMEOUT_S=75s caps any sustained move-away-from-goal excursion at roughly 225m (75s * 3 m/s) before the run is forced to 'stalled'. No sol plan can both stay within that stall grace and reach a >=32deg cell, so 'tipped' cannot be produced near this goal by any guardrail/drift combination without changing DRIFT_PCT (forbidden) or terrain/mission logic (out of this lane's file ownership).
